name: Renewal generated under RLM Quote DML lock (initiateRenewal headless, no Apex Quote DML)
expected: With RLM/Subscription Mgmt enabled, the renewal QLI seed must apply COLA + pipe-delimited Description WITHOUT relying on Apex Quote DML (which the scenario premises is platform-blocked and would silently fail); seed must route through the platform initiateRenewal API + Reprice-All prehook context-writes / event paths, not an Apex update on Quote/QuoteLineItem.
actual: Empirical probe on FortraUAT (Savepoint+rollback, no persistence): Apex 'update QuoteLineItem' = QLI_UPDATE_SUCCEEDED; Apex 'update Quote' (allOrNone=true) = QUOTE_UPDATE_SUCCEEDED; Database.update(Quote, allOrNone=false) = SOFT_QUOTE_UPDATE_SUCCEEDED. The premise that all Quote DML is platform-blocked is REFUTED in this org. The actual seed path is lock-immune by design: COLAUpliftPrehook.buildLineItemUpdates returns context-update payloads (List<Map>) consumed by the pricing-engine write-back, NOT Apex QLI DML; QLDescriptionGeneratorPrehook likewise emits context-update payloads; the only Apex DML in the seed path are RenewalAssetQuantityHandler L139/142 (update QuoteAction + update QuoteLineItem, allOrNone=true, in a Queueable) and COLAUpliftPrehook.MyCAPFlagApplier L1397 (Database.update Quote.Mycap__c, allOrNone=false) — and BOTH DML targets are proven WRITABLE, so no silent lock-swallow. Force-reprice of real renewal Quote 0Q0WC00000382MH0AY (Quote_Type__c=Renewal, Status=Draft, Fortra Price Book active, USD) returned isSuccess=true / errorResponse=[]; maint line 0QLWC000003dEW24AM (PIA-PIA-RRM-PIAM, QA.Type=Renew, SourceAsset.Price=60.64) seeded Description='Powertech Identity & Access Manager (BoKS)-RenewalMaintenance | Standard', NetUnitPrice=NetTotalPrice=67.38, COLACalculatedPrice__c=65.4, COLA_Uplift_Percent__c=7.85 — COLA + description applied with zero Apex Quote DML and no lock error.
evidence: Probe log markers: F10_QLI_DML=QLI_UPDATE_SUCCEEDED, F10_QUOTE_DML=QUOTE_UPDATE_SUCCEEDED, F10_QUOTE_SOFT_DML=SOFT_QUOTE_UPDATE_SUCCEEDED (scratchpad/f10_dml_probe.apex on FortraUAT). Live classes Data/sc3473/seed_classes/unpackaged/classes/: COLAUpliftPrehook.cls (buildLineItemUpdates L314-322 context payloads; MyCAPFlagApplier L1363-1408 only Quote.Mycap__c DML), QLDescriptionGeneratorPrehook.cls (context-update payloads L329/723/777, no QLI DML), RenewalAssetQuantityHandler.cls L138-143 (update QuoteAction + QuoteLineItem). Live flow Data/sc3473/f10_reverify/unpackaged/flows/Fortra_Create_Renewal_Quote.flow (initiateRenewal action + Flow recordUpdates on QuoteLineItem/Quote, NOT Apex DML; identical element set to F-04 retrieve). Repriced record: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC00000382MH0AY/view ; QLI https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003dEW24AM/view ; REST place isSuccess=true errorResponse=[].
proposedFix: None required for the DML-lock premise (no defect). Catalog premise correction: the RLM Quote-DML lock is NOT a blanket block in FortraUAT — it only blocks editing/deleting EXISTING managed Quotes carrying the RLM application-usage assignment (SC-3137 prod-purge scope). Apex update of Quote/QuoteLineItem succeeds here. The real renewal-at-generation gap (COLA + description absent until a manual reprice) is the F-04 defect: Fortra_Create_Renewal_Quote never fires Reprice-All after initiateRenewal, so the prehook context-write seed never executes at generation — root cause is the missing Reprice-All trigger, NOT a DML lock. Fix tracked under F-04/SC-3354 (add a Place/Force-reprice step or move COLA/description to a post-create after-insert trigger).
notes: F-10 verifies the Quote-DML-lock CONSTRAINT (sibling to F-04's prehook-bypass). Premise empirically false in this org: the RLM lock per [[project_rlm_quote_dml_lock]] verified scope is editing/deleting existing managed Quotes, not routine Apex Quote/QLI updates (fresh inserts + updates succeed in FortraUAT). The seed architecture is correctly lock-immune regardless: COLA/description seed via pricing-engine context-write payloads, not Apex QLI DML, so there is no silent-lock-swallow surface to fail. The two Apex DML sites in the seed path (RenewalAssetQuantityHandler QLI/QuoteAction update; COLAUpliftPrehook.MyCAPFlagApplier Quote.Mycap__c update) target objects that are proven writable, so they do not silently fail under the lock. Sibling $0 line 0QLWC000003dEW14AM (HRM-HRM-RSL-10L50CS, SourceAsset.Price=0) is the known zero-source-asset condition (F-06/F-02 memory), not a lock failure. Active proc=Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 (design 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY), context SalesTransactionContextExt_v2 v23. Read-only + Savepoint-rollback probe + Force-reprice only; no deploys/edits.
verdict_reason: The renewal seed applies COLA + pipe-delimited Description via lock-immune pricing-engine context-writes (not Apex Quote DML), the Force-reprice succeeded (isSuccess=true), and direct Apex Quote/QLI DML is empirically PERMITTED in this org — so the scenario's DML-lock failure premise is an EXPECTATION-ERROR with no procedure/config defect; the only real renewal-generation gap is F-04's missing Reprice-All trigger.
